output.risk_rationale: As of 2026-11-03, the DNB public-register record identifies Adyen N.V. (Chamber of Commerce 34259528; LEI 724500973ODKK3IFQ447) at Simon Carmiggeltstraat 6, Amsterdam, and the LEI record corroborates ACTIVE status and an entity creation date of 2006-11-24. Adyen's current governance page identifies the Management Board, interim CFO and Supervisory Board listed above; it did not state their nationalities, and no current PSC/UBO entry was available from the opened sources. The OFAC name search returned no result for Adyen, the UK Sanctions List search returned no result, and the EU financial-sanctions search returned no result (sources: https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/; https://sanctionslist.fcdo.gov.uk/docs/UK-Sanctions-List.xml; https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/fsd/fsf/public/files/xmlFullSanctionsList_1_1/content). The available screening also returned no sanctions-topic result for Pieter van der Does in OpenSanctions (https://www.opensanctions.org/search/?q=Pieter+van+der+Does&topics=sanction). No adverse-media item was retained because the opened sources did not tie an enforcement action, fine, fraud, money-laundering or corruption allegation, sanctions-evasion matter, or lawsuit in the last ten years specifically to Adyen N.V. or the identified officers. The rating is low on the evidence reviewed, with direct Dutch Handelsregister/UBO verification still advisable because it was not available from the opened sources.
